cases.given: scratch git repo, local bare origin, branches cut from main
cases.when: the function or script runs against the hostile names

seeds.title: branches.parse accepts non-ASCII digits
seeds.detail: The row patterns use \d on str, so feature/PROJ-1-M-٣ parses as a milestone and feature/PROJ-1-run-٢ as a run. The prune would delete such a shipped branch. Use [0-9] or re.ASCII.

seeds.title: branch_run raises on a committed config that is not an object
seeds.detail: config.json holding [1] on a leftover branch gives AttributeError from .get. The line is older than S-033 but the slice names this function. ensure_milestone_branch would stop with a traceback.

seeds.title: janitor does not validate the format it loads
seeds.detail: Only split() runs. Formats with an unbalanced brace, whitespace, NUL, .., ~ or .lock pass silently. A non-string branchFormat reads as absent, so the janitor sweeps under sdlc/{name} with no note. Call validate_format and add a note for a non-string value.

seeds.title: scenario VS-5 note differs from the janitor rule
seeds.detail: The plan says a branch whose slice is not in the ledger stays. The janitor docstring says it goes. The run followed the docstring.
